A bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] '''[[species]]''' with distinguishably small [[mouth]]s and [[Color|tan]] skin existed in [[the galaxy]]. In [[5 BBY]], one member of the species walked around on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]]. [[Standard decade|Decades]] later, in [[35 ABY]], another member of the species was in a [[Cantina|bar]] at [[Kijimi City]] of the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]].

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their small [[mouth]]s and [[Color|tan]] skin.<ref name="TROS" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Unidentified-Small-Mouthed-Species-BTS.png|thumb|left|250px|The species behind the scenes of Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]
During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]], in [[5 BBY]], a member of this species was present on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]], walking around herkily jerkily behind [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] shortly before [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation]] [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|agent]] [[Syril Karn]] arrived.<ref name="Episode">{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}}</ref> Much later, in [[35 ABY]],<ref name="TROSDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' to [[35 ABY]].</ref> another member of this species could be found in a bar in [[Kijimi City]] on [[Kijimi]] when [[Poe Dameron]] and company arrived looking for his old acquaintance, the [[Anzellan]] [[Babu Frik]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wizard-58.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Wizard 58 by Luke Fisher]]
The species made their debut in the [[2019]] film ''[[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker]]'', directed by [[J.J. Abrams]].<ref name="TROS" /> The concept art for this species was created by concept artist and sculptor [[Luke Fisher]].<ref name="Concept Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref>
